# 25X Academy

> 25X Academy is an AI education company in Chennai, India, founded by John V Jayakumar. It teaches business owners and professionals (speakers, trainers, coaches, consultants, CAs, clinics, agencies and founders) to use AI in their own business: to build business tools that win customers, save hours and create new products, without coding or hiring developers.

Programs are live and hands-on. The entry point is the 3-Day Business Tools Workshop: 3 live evenings on Zoom (Monday to Wednesday, 7:30 to 8:30 PM IST), ₹99 for all 3, registered at vibecoding77.com. Next steps are BuildAlong Hub (12 weeks, weekly live Build Nights) and the Startup Intensive (1 year, 25 startups a year, by application).
